verdict.rationale: Rainforest is an embedded payments infrastructure platform (APIs, embeddable components, webhooks), not an AI agent or assistant that consumes tools. Plugging MCP servers into it as a client is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
